hero.headline: Real-world Spanish for Real-world Success
hero.subtext: Master practical fluency and professional communication. Skip the grammar drills and start speaking with confidence.

features.heading: Fluency Over Formulas
features.description: Traditional classes focus on memorization. We focus on getting you ready for that important meeting, your next date, or your new life abroad.

conversational.title: Conversational Fluency
conversational.desc: Speak naturally from day one. We simulate real conversations so you aren't lost when you step outside the classroom.

professional.title: Professional Communication
professional.desc: Master the vocabulary that matters for your career. Learn how to negotiate, present, and build relationships in Spanish.

real_world.title: Real-world Application
real_world.desc: Roleplay scenarios tailored to your life: ordering at a local cafe, handling a bureaucratic office, or chatting with in-laws.

dialects.title: Specialized Dialects
dialects.desc: We offer specialized dialect coaching so students can learn the exact Spanish they need — including Argentinian, Chilean, Mexican, European Spanish (Castilian), and more.

audience.heading: Who is FluentPath For?
audience.description: Our coaching is designed specifically for intermediate-to-advanced learners who need to bridge the gap between "knowing Spanish" and actually using it confidently.
audience.expats: Expats & Remote Workers: Feel at home in LATAM or Spain.
audience.relocating: Relocating Professionals: Hit the ground running in your new office.
audience.business: Business Developers: Close deals in Spanish-speaking markets.
audience.partners: Partners & Spouses: Connect deeply with Spanish-speaking loved ones.
audience.rusty: Rusty Learners: Reactivate the Spanish you learned years ago.

testimonials.heading: Success Stories
testimonials.description: Hear from professionals who have transformed their Spanish and their careers.
testimonials.quote1: "The dialect coaching was a game-changer. I needed Argentinian Spanish for my new role in Buenos Aires, and FluentPath delivered exactly what I needed."
testimonials.quote2: "I finally feel confident speaking up in meetings. The focus on professional communication rather than just grammar made all the difference."
testimonials.quote3: "The flexible scheduling and 1-on-1 attention were perfect for my busy lifestyle. My Spanish improved dramatically in just a few months."

roadmap.heading: Your Learning Journey
roadmap.description: A guided path from finding your level to booking your first session. Follow these steps to make the most of FluentPath.
roadmap.step1_desc: Find your current level with our 15-question placement quiz covering beginner to advanced topics. Get a personalized recommendation.
roadmap.step2_desc: Choose from 5 dialects (Mexican, Cuban, Rioplatense, Chilean, Colombian) and test your regional vocabulary knowledge.
roadmap.step3_desc: Master 7-8 essential vocabulary words per dialect with interactive flip cards. Shuffle and review until you remember them all.
roadmap.step4_desc: Ready to take the next step? Book a 1-on-1 session, join a group class, or subscribe for unlimited weekly coaching.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need to be fluent to start?
faq.a1: No, but our coaching is designed for intermediate-to-advanced learners. If you know the basics but struggle to use them in real conversation, we're the perfect fit.
faq.q2: How does the 7-day free trial work?
faq.a2: When you sign up for our subscription plan, your first 7 days are completely free. You can attend unlimited sessions and cancel anytime before the trial ends without being charged.
faq.a3: Yes! If your needs change, you can let your coach know, and we will adjust the focus of your sessions to the specific dialect you require.
